in_arabic.name: عرقبانت
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عرق و بان و تهليل لله
in_arabic.long_meaning: العرقبانت هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي عرق، و يعني الشخص الذي يعرق في سبيل الله، و يبتهل إليه، و اسم يوحي بالتوكل على الله و الإخلاص له، و يعتبر من الأسماء ذات المعنى العميق في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: عرقبانت
in_urdu.meaning: عربی جڑوں سے بنا ہوا نام، معنوی قربانی دینے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عرقبانت ایک عربی نام ہے جو عرق، قرب، اور ایمان کی جڑوں سے بنا ہے، اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا تعلق قربانی دینے اور روحانی سفر سے ہے، جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے یہ نام خاص معانی رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: عرقبانت
in_hindi.meaning: अरबी जड़ों से बना हुआ नाम, अर्थ आत्म समर्पण
in_hindi.long_meaning: عرقبانت एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है खुद को समर्पित करना और ईश्वर की राह में कुछ भी देने के लिए तैयार रहना, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का विशेष महत्व है.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Irqbaanht" signifies power and strength in Islamic culture. It is a name that relates to courage and valor, and is often given to boys who are expected to grow up and become strong and fearless leaders. The name is derived from the Arabic word "irqab," meaning "horse," which symbolizes strength and power. In the Islamic world, horses have long held a place of great honor and respect, representing not only physical strength but also bravery and battle prowess. Therefore, the name "Irqbaanht" carries a powerful cultural message of strength, courage, and respectability.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Irqbaanht" signifies the belief in the power and strength of God. It is a reminder that true power and strength come from faith and reliance on God, rather than from worldly possessions or physical strength. The name encourages the bearer to strive for inner strength and courage, to face challenges with faith and determination, and to seek guidance and support from God in times of difficulty. Ultimately, the name "Irqbaanht" is a reflection of the Islamic belief in the power and mercy of God, and is a reminder to constantly seek His guidance and strength in all aspects of life.
